entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV desktop Rive animation viewer. The public 2.4.3 release uses direct or unique canonical-string ViewModel list labels; one full-width image-source select with embedded rasters, Open file, and Clear; overflow-safe canvas centering; safe runtime 2.39.2 by default; applied-editor-aware standalone export; a dedicated Windows .riv document icon; and event inspection.
